spec: §8.1: "A target is a JSON document in RFC 8785 canonical form; target_hash = SHA-256 of those bytes"; §10 bennett_load takes target_jcs
derivation: noncanonical.json deliberately appends LF to target.json canonical bytes. §8.1 requires canonical input, hence the semantic outcome is rejection for noncanonical JCS, not execution. Only while the target CLI surface is unavailable may the explicit deliverable-9 refusal stand in for that check.
